description: This file defines an abstract class 'Player' that encapsulates common media playback operations such as play, pause, seek, and stop, and supports different implementations like RemotePlayer and LocalPlayer. It serves as the backbone for media playback management in an Android media router application.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: Abstract class that provides common playback operations for media items, serving as a base for specific player implementations like RemotePlayer and LocalPlayer.

methods.name: isRemotePlayback
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the player performs remote playback.

methods.name: isQueuingSupported
methods.description: Abstract method to check if advanced queuing is supported.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Abstract method to establish connection with a media route.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Abstract method to release resources associated with the player.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Abstract method to start playback of a playlist item.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Abstract method to seek within a playlist item.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Abstract method to get the status of a playlist item.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Abstract method to add an item to the playback queue (supported if isQueuingSupported() returns true).

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove an item from the queue by ID.

methods.name: updateStatistics
methods.description: Optional method to update route statistics.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Returns string with route statistics info.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Optional method to update presentation display information.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback listener for playback events such as error, completion, playlist changes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a Player implementation based on the route capabilities.
